actual_game_ui: No supported runtime slots; not an adoption review.

cells.subject: cinder-mantle
cells.notes: Open neckline, swept folds and warm lining read well at 80px. Clasp remains a supported closure; quiet broad fabric planes.

cells.subject: glassworker-visor
cells.notes: Glazed pane and two fitted hinge supports read clearly. Glass is conveyed by broad reflection/transmission shapes, not physically transparent rendering.

cells.subject: rootstep-boots
cells.notes: Distinct planted/tilted boots with sole exposure and moss leather folds. Measured top bound is 31.42px within the requested 30px margin; visual concern about tight padding was resolved by source-size bounds check. No fit adaptation needed.

cells.subject: choir-bracers
cells.notes: The paired front/side views have real open lining and clear slotted plates; distinct from full arms or gloves.

cells.subject: slag-belt
cells.notes: Large buckle, C-curved strap and two fitted pouches read at native and compact sizes; strap notches are secondary.

cells.subject: cistern-torc
cells.notes: Open ring and asymmetrical ceramic cup terminal are distinct. Fine edge chips recede; still reads as a thick torc rather than a medallion.

aesthetic_acceptance: User acceptance pending; no reroll. All six remain optional concepts.
